defs.def: despite the fact that 虽然；尽管；即使

ex.s: Though I lived _____42_____ three and a half hours away, most of my classmates thought of Ohio as a whole different world.
ex.t: 尽管我住的地方____只有三个半小时的车程，但大多数同学都觉得俄亥俄完全像是另一个世界。

ex.s: Even though I’m a grown woman in my 40s with my own family, it felt scary not to have “home” to go back to.
ex.t: 在这所房子里的最后一个早晨，我们从令人头疼、永无止境的打包工作中抽空坐下来吃最后一顿早餐。

ex.s: Even though we have other valuable things endangered by climate change, like food access, there is also an element of cultural identity, cultural survival, and history.
ex.t: 如果我们不关注它，我们将失去其背后所有的丰富内涵。

ex.s: Though friendly, he could easily knock over my niece’s small boys and my six-month-old granddaughter.
ex.t: 考虑我们所讲述关于自己的故事可以帮助我们更好地改变想法。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 一位乘务员给了我们一些重庆旅游手册。

ex.s: He never got into trouble, though sometimes he wanted to do risky things.
ex.t: 14 这位女士今天早上听了谁的演讲？

ex.s: The truth, though, is ____13____ could be guessed — there’s never anyone else here.
ex.t: 第一段中划线的词语"jump on that bandwagon"是什么意思？

ex.s: Though they are useful for detecting shifts in the number and variety of species in an area, a new Stanford study has found that this type of record is not perfect.
ex.t: 尽管它们有助于探测一个地区物种数量和种类的变化，但斯坦福大学的一项新研究发现，这类记录并不完美。

ex.s: Though overtourism is described as a problem affecting the entire world, it’s actually concentrated to a small number of extremely popular spots.
ex.t: 尽管过度旅游被描述为一个影响全世界的问题，但它实际上集中在极少数极受欢迎的景点。

ex.s: However, though it’s nice to get a few cents off a pack of sausages, it would help even more if they could sometimes   61   (offer) in smaller packs.
ex.t: 根据以赛亚·伯林的观点，刺猬精通一件事，而狐狸通晓许多事。

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 不同文化间道德美德的相似性令人瞩目，尽管美德的相对排名可能因社会群体的历史和环境而异。

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Not the pandas, even though ___59___ language used for the medical training instructions is actually English.
ex.t: 不是熊猫，尽管___59___用于医疗训练指令的语言实际上是英语。

ex.s: Though DIY has traditionally been seen as male hobby, the research shows it is women now leading the charge.
ex.t: 尽管DIY传统上被视为男性的爱好，但研究显示，如今是女性冲在最前面。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国菜以平庸著称，但英国正在培养越来越多的顶级厨师，他们频繁出现在我们的电视屏幕上，他们的食谱书也经常登上畅销书榜榜首。

ex.s: Brilliant though it is, Project Debater has some weaknesses.
ex.t: 尽管"辩论手项目"非常出色，但它也有一些弱点。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都需要占用大量空间，尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，但很少有人喜欢在自家附近安装大型太阳能电池板。

ex.s: As my eyes rested on them, I felt as though I were looking through a window into my own past.
ex.t: 让我们从查看《学生指南》开始你的学术旅程吧！

ex.s: After I got home, though.
ex.t: 事实和数据。

ex.s: They should give strong consideration to universities where high-quality teaching is valued, even though the schools may be ranked lower.
ex.t: 他们应该认真考虑那些重视高质量教学的大学，即使这些学校的排名较低。

ex.s: Even though this technique won't work for everyone, it helps many people get a good store of ideas to draw on.
ex.t: 虽然这种技巧不一定对每个人都有效，但它帮助许多人积累了大量可供借鉴的想法。

ex.s: Though not known to use tools in the wild, the birds have proved skilful at tool use while kept in the cage.
ex.t: 虽然它们在野外不被认为会使用工具，但这些鸟在被关在笼子里时证明了自己善于使用工具。

ex.s: We ______51______ to date, though neither of us brought up the future.
ex.t: 我们______51______继续约会，虽然我们谁都没提起未来。

ex.s: It's a call she must heed alone, though.
ex.t: 这是一个她必须独自响应的召唤。

ex.s: He looked at me as though I weren't there.
ex.t: 他看着我就像我不存在一样。

ex.s: I felt he treated me as though I would hold him back and probably make him fail to get an A in the course.
ex.t: 我感觉他对待我的态度就好像我会拖他的后腿，可能会使他在这门课上拿不到A。

ex.s: In his spare time though he goes on stage beside pianist Maria Raspopova — not as a musician but as her page turner.
ex.t: 但在业余时间，他登上舞台站在钢琴家玛丽亚·拉斯波波娃身边——不是作为音乐家，而是作为她的翻谱员。

ex.s: The place wasn’t entirely authentic, though.
ex.t: 37 我们的楼里甚至有一部小型电梯，有个女声会说完美的法语："Ouverture des portes"（门开了）。

ex.s: Though it is the only unnatural thing on your way up the mountain, still it highlights the whole adventure ___62___ offers a place where you can sit down to rest your ___63___ (ache) legs.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的路"永远不会消失"，它会永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: Even though he often felt he would be discovered to be a no-talent, he moved forward, gaining a scholarship to the Neighborhood Playhouse and making his first television appearance a few years later in 1948.
ex.t: 但即使那时他所拥有的也不是他真正想要的。

ex.s: It was tiring work, but I looked forward to the pay, even though I wasn’t sure how much it would amount to.
ex.t: 这是累人的活但我期待着报酬虽然我不确定会有多少。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 有时设备失败是因为一个好的设计使用了低质量材料且施工不当。

ex.s: Reaching the end of the hallway, though, Grant____28____a half-open door.
ex.t: 他一脚踢开，发现一名____29____坐在轮椅上的妇女带着一个小男孩和一个婴儿。

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总是用不同的声音朗读，就像我在用声音表演故事一样，他们很喜欢！那是与孩子们建立联系的特别时光，充满了书籍带来的奇妙感觉。

ex.s: This isn’t usual though.
ex.t: 这并不常见。

ex.s: How much, though?
ex.t: 至少看起来是这样。

ex.s: I didn't feel as though I needed to keep up with anybody else; I was finally with peers who understood me.
ex.t: 我感觉不需要跟上任何人；我终于和懂我的同龄人在一起了。

ex.s: Though Smith did get her hands on the best sand, doing things the old-fashioned way isn't just about playing around with French mud.
ex.t: 这项工作也为博物馆带来了启示，史密斯说。

ex.s: At present, these technologies are still expensive, though.
ex.t: 目前，这些技术仍然很昂贵。

ex.s: Even though there is a common spirit among all music groups, they make very different music. ___31___ At that time the Beatles entered the world of music from Liverpool.
ex.t: 摇滚音乐包含许多不同的风格。

ex.s: C．even thoughD．so that
ex.t: A．当然 B．看情况 C．算了吧 D．开玩笑

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在马莱塔——所罗门群岛人口最多的岛屿——贝壳在大多数地方都被接受，"你的贝壳能换多少金枪鱼取决于它们的颜色和形状，"来自马莱塔小镇奥基的店主玛丽·布鲁诺告诉Vice杂志。

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 为什么联合国教科文组织将4月30日定为国际爵士乐日？

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 挖一个一定尺寸的洞。

ex.s: Though the movie is 30 years old, most of the 250 seats were filled with teary-eyed audience wanting to say good-bye to the old building.
ex.t: 尽管这部电影已有30年历史，但250个座位几乎坐满了眼含泪水的观众，他们想向这座老建筑告别。

ex.s: Italians always “see me as a foreigner,” an outsider, even though she’s stayed in the country for years and can speak the local language fluently, she said.
ex.t: 意大利人总是"把我当作外国人"，一个局外人，尽管她在这个国家生活多年并且能流利地说当地语言，她说。

ex.s: The idea is that white coats are associated with scientists, who are in turn though to have close attention to detail.
ex.t: 身体动作改变人们的思维方式

ex.s: Their research also suggests how we may build lasting memories over time even though the synapses become thinner.
ex.t: 托尼的团队测量了12只小鼠大脑中这些连接即突触的大小。

ex.s: Strangely, his beard is still red even though his hair is turning grey!
ex.t: 奇怪的是，尽管他的头发正变得花白，他的胡子却依然是红色的！

ex.s: Though there are many large, flat areas in the region, they built terraces on the mountains to have more areas to grow rice.
ex.t: 尽管该地区有许多大而平坦的地方，他们还是在山上修建梯田，以获得更多种植水稻的面积。

defs.def: （用于主句后，引出补充说明，使语气变弱）不过，可是，然而

ex.s: Something could go wrong, though, according to a new study.
ex.t: 不过，一项新研究指出，事情也可能出问题。

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个重要的建议是选择一个有意义的日子，作为新“篇章”开始的标志。

ex.s: I do remember, though, what it was like to be a complete beginner.
ex.t: 不过，我确实记得完全作为新手是什么感觉。

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.
ex.t: 不过在这个过程中我也学到了一些东西，希望如果你也在尽力想办法在一个不太支持的家庭环境中做出改变，这些经验能给你带来鼓励。

ex.s: It is fair to say, though, that our psychological biases play a major role.
ex.t: 不过公平地说，我们的心理偏见起着主要作用。

ex.s: Mum looks almost the same, though.
ex.t: 不过，妈妈看起来几乎没什么变化。

ex.s: I still don’t think that anything can beat my mum’s homemade sausages, though.
ex.t: 不过，我仍然觉得任何东西都比不上妈妈自制的香肠。

ex.s: It can be quite stressful at times, though, which in turn makes me feel anxious.
ex.t: 不过，有时这会让人压力很大，而这又让我感到焦虑。
